content.short: ei8hts reimagines classic games by adding a Web3 twist.
content.description: Traditional classic games are limited by the range of modes and the ownership options for in-game items. ei8hts introduces NFT-powered twists that unlock fresh gameplay experiences and genuine ownership of digital purchases. Players can test their skills against the computer, team up with friends, or compete in prize-filled tournaments. The platform is intuitive and welcoming for users of all ages and skill levels, giving players greater control over how they play, trade, and own their gaming assets, while enjoying new ways to challenge themselves.
